Product Description: Engineered to deliver explosive impact from the smallest space possible, this single loudspeaker covers the entire audible spectrum. The Krakatoa focuses its output of seismic bass, crystal-clear highs, and everything in between, from a single point.
Technical Table:
Kicks Some Serious Ash

Engineered to deliver explosive impact from the smallest space possible, this single loudspeaker covers the entire audible spectrum. The Krakatoa focuses its output of seismic bass, crystal-clear highs, and everything in between, from a single point.



Seismic Sound

The Krakatoa delivers all sounds seamlessly from a single point. This ensures the most naturally realistic listening experience that a loudspeaker can produce. Practically eliminating phase interference affords superior sound localization, which allows more precise imaging, immersing listeners in an immense, sharply focused sound field. This is the real immersive.



Volcanic Volume

The Krakatoa is a true full range – from deep, powerful bass to crisp highs, delivering every note with clarity and precision. Its 4-way design assigns each frequency range to dedicated drivers, reducing distortion and ensuring balanced, dynamic sound even at high volumes. How big does it sound? If you hear it before you see it, you won't believe how small it is...


You'll Lava It!

The Stack-a-Toa combines the Kraken Quad 21” Subwoofer, the Makara Double 21” Subwoofer, and the Krakatoa into a vertically stacked powerhouse of sound, delivering massive SPL from a remarkably small “dance stack” design.
